subject: Revised MAP and go-live window — OliveHealth
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@olivehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@olivehealth.com
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Revised MAP and go-live window — OliveHealth

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Quick update from our side after the security evidence review this morning — the SOC team surfaced two additional sections where they need deeper evidence (process screenshots + retention logs) before they can sign off. That adds an estimated 10 business days to their internal review.

For context:
- Original MAP close: 2026-02-26
- SOC now expects completion ~2026-03-10

This will cascade into procurement signoff and our board reporting. Procurement looped me in, they asked for a revised MAP and any mitigation commitments that could shorten the window. I attached the evidence request list we shared with the SOC reviewers (OliveHealth_Security_QA.pdf).

As next steps, can you:
1) Share an updated MAP with dates and explicit owner(s) for the outstanding evidence items?
2) Propose any mitigations (workarounds, temporary controls) that let us keep a partial go-live for non-sensitive flows while SOC finishes the rest?

Procurement is asking to understand commercial relief options if the go-live slips beyond Feb. Appreciate a fast turnaround — can we aim for an updated MAP by EOD Tuesday, 2026-02-03?

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Director, Cloud Security — OliveHealth
procurement@olivehealth.com

Attachment: OliveHealth_Security_QA.pdf (PDF, 18 pages, redacted)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Revised MAP and go-live window — OliveHealth

Emma — thanks for the heads up and the attachment. We ran a quick internal triage this morning with Product and Security. High level proposal below; I attached an editable MAP (JW_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a short risk log (CloseRisk_Log_olivehealth.csv).

Proposed re-baseline (minimizes business impact):
- New target partial go-live (non-PHI flows): 2026-03-05
- Full production (post-SOC signoff): 2026-03-12

Mitigations we can commit to immediately:
- Temporary masking on high-sensitivity payloads at the API gateway (reduction of blast radius) — engineering ETA: 48 hours
- Daily evidence bundle delivery to OliveHealth SOC (until complete) — responsible: Laura Bennett
- 30-min twice-weekly sync with your SOC and our security lead to accelerate clarifications

Action items for Tuesday EOD (requested):
- We will deliver JW_MAP_v2.xlsx with explicit owners and date-by-date checklist (assigned to Marissa for MAP updates).
- Rishi will scope any perf/regression risk introduced by the masking change and provide rollback criteria.

We understand procurement will need a revised SOW + timeline; happy to produce that once we have your confirmation on the proposed dates. If OliveHealth prefers a shorter partial go-live window, we can prioritize evidence items — please highlight the top 2 evidence artefacts SOC needs to unblock the highest-value flows.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: JW_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP workbook), CloseRisk_Log_olivehealth.csv (risk log)
From: OliveHealth Procurement <procurement@olivehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Liu <emma.liu@olivehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Revised MAP and go-live window — OliveHealth

Jonas / Emma,

Thanks for the quick response and the proposed dates. Procurement has two asks to align internally:
1) Commercial relief: because the approved budget cycle is impacted by the go-live shift, we need to discuss a short-term credit or pro-rated invoice adjustment if the production date slips past 2026-03-01.
2) Contract amendment: please provide a redlined SOW with the new Milestone dates so our legal team can review. We prefer DocuSign for any formal acceptance.

Procurement note to internal stakeholders: the board will expect either proof of a firm mitigation path or commercial remediation. If you can provide the revised MAP + SOW by Thursday EOD (2026-02-05), we can move this through our legal queue and avoid exec escalation.

DocuSign reference: https://docusign.com/abcdef

Best,
OliveHealth Procurement Team
procurement@olivehealth.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Feb 2026 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Revised MAP and go-live window — OliveHealth | escalation

Folks — forwarding the thread. Procurement is explicitly asking for commercial relief and a redlined SOW by Thu EOD. Security has requested additional artefacts that add ~10 business days unless we accelerate evidence delivery.

Immediate asks (owners & deadlines):
- Marissa: finalize MAP spreadsheet (JW_MAP_v2.xlsx) with per-item owners and daily evidence delivery schedule. Due: Tue 2026-02-10 EOD.
- Laura: assemble the SOC evidence bundle (screenshots, retention configs, logs) and commit to daily delivery. We need the first bundle in 48 hours.
- Rishi: validate the gateway masking approach (perf/regression checklist + rollback criteria). Due: Mon 2026-02-09 midday.
- Finance/Sales (internal): prepare a commercial remediation recommendation (credit % / pro-rate model) for exec review. I will route that to VP Sales once we have a concrete proposal.

If we can meet the evidence delivery cadence + provide a redlined SOW, procurement indicated they can avoid escalating to their C-suite. I have blocked a 30-minute session with OliveHealth SOC for Monday 2026-02-09 10:00 PST — please keep that slot available.

Quote of procurement: "if you can provide the revised MAP + SOW by Thursday EOD (2026-02-05), we can move this through our legal queue and avoid exec escalation."

I'll follow up with a short escalation note for Sales leadership summarizing the credit ask and recommended commercial levers.

-Jonas

Attachment: Escalation_Notes_olivehealth.txt (internal summary, 1 page)
